description: Spectrum TG45SC-E Petrol Scarifier & Aerator - 223cc, 45cm, Electric Key Start
marketingText: The Spectrum TG45SC-E takes the same 2-in-1 scarifier and aerator platform as our standard TG45SC and adds an electric key-start system - turn a key, the engine fires, you're working. No recoil pull, no wrenched shoulders on a cold morning, no half-dozen attempts when the engine has sat over winter. Key start (with recoil backup) The electric key start is the easiest-to-use ignition on any scarifier in this price band. An on-board battery cranks the engine on demand; a traditional recoil starter is retained as a backup if the battery is flat. Worth the upgrade for anyone with a shoulder, back or grip issue that makes recoil starting a chore - or anyone who simply prefers turning a key over yanking a cord. Two jobs, one machine The TG45SC-E ships with a 45cm scarifier cassette fitted as standard, with an aerator cassette included in the box. Swap cassettes by hand - no tools, no fuss - and you've got a single machine that strips moss and thatch in spring, then opens compacted soil in autumn. Buying separate scarifying and aerating machines costs the best part of a thousand pounds for a comparable specification. 223cc petrol engine The 223cc engine produces 6hp / 4.5kW - enough power to keep the 18 scarifier blades cutting through dense thatch without stalling. Standard unleaded fuel, 3.6-litre tank. Designed for lawns up to 2,000m². Six working-height positions, from -12mm to +10mm A single lever adjusts the cassette height across six positions. Run at -12mm for an aggressive thatch strip, +10mm to lightly tickle the surface of a newer lawn. Adjustability matters most when you're working different lawns or recovering from a bad winter. Blade-engage clutch - leave the engine running A green engagement lever clutches the blades in and out independently of the engine. Stop to empty the 45-litre collector, lift the machine over a path, reposition for a second pass - the engine stays running. Built around a steel deck A pressed steel deck holds the blade shafts in true alignment under load - the single most important thing for cassette life and cutting consistency. Foldable soft-grip handles fold down for storage, and double ball-bearing wheels push smoothly across rough ground. description: Spectrum 122cm Steel Towed Spike-Type Roller Aerator | SP31130
marketingText: Spectrum SP31130 Towed Spike Aerator With this tow-behind spike aerator from Spectrum at your disposal, you'll be able to achieve thorough, deep-level aeration, without leaving your lawn strewn with unsightly soil plugs, as happens with core-type aerators. The Spectrum SP31130 Roller Aerator features a series of 108, sharp steel spikes, which will open-up almost invisible slits in the turf to allow air, moisture and nutrients to better penetrate, which in turn encourages vigorous, verdant growth. Additionally, this process will relieve soil compaction on high-footfall areas. Capable of being ballasted with up to 114 litres of water, the Spectrum SP31130 Towed Spike-Type Roller Aerator can be made as heavy as the condition of your lawn requires (the maximum aeration depth is 6.4cm). Manufactured from heavy-duty steel with a protective powder-coated paint finish, the Spectrum SP31130 will give you season upon season of unfailing service. A universal hitchpin enables compatiblity with all makes and models of tow-capable garden tractor.
